bhair-p01-v01.speaker: Kṣemarāja (invoking voice)
bhair-p01-v01.question: Who is saluted, and who should shelter?
premises: Oṃ. Obeisance to Consciousness-Bhairava.
Ground-shelter-takers of consciousness-ground: take consciousness-state, wander not in vain.
Proclaiming thus, Śiva grace-bent conquers — of devotees.
bhair-p01-v01.inference: Salute Bhairava; shelter in ground; wander not; Śiva conquers.

bhair-p01-v02.speaker: Kṣemarāja (devotee voice)
bhair-p01-v02.question: Which Bhairava is venerated?
premises: Consciousness-Bhairava alone — supreme, supreme-nectar-formed, one, high-blazing.
All-swallowed by shining-faculty-ring — Śiva I venerate.

bhair-p01-v03.speaker: Kṣemarāja (devotee voice)
bhair-p01-v03.question: Do praised, praiser, praise differ?
premises: Praised, praiser, praise — though distinct, nothing here is.
Endures: as whatever form by consciousness-form, so becomes this.

bhair-p01-v04.speaker: Kṣemarāja (devotee voice)
bhair-p01-v04.question: Whose imitation is venerated?
premises: All-distinctions-melted, all-distinction-self, consciousness-mass-bliss —
Which Your principle, Lord — its imitation, Your form — I venerate.
bhair-p01-v04.inference: Melted-distinction bliss; Your principle imitated in Your form venerated.

bhair-p01-v05.speaker: Kṣemarāja (devotee voice)
bhair-p01-v05.question: How does shape reveal?
premises: Outline-man, man, letter-script, letter-mass — as, so varied-formed You —
Shape reveals, supreme self.
bhair-p01-v05.inference: As script outlines man, shape reveals varied You.

bhair-p01-v06.speaker: Kṣemarāja (devotee voice)
bhair-p01-v06.question: What reflects concept-free?
premises: There concept-free indeed — You consciousness-formed entered —
We reflect: what even a bit? Not indeed principle fancy's-object.
bhair-p01-v06.inference: Entered concept-free, we reflect: fancy never principle.

bhair-p01-v07.speaker: Kṣemarāja (devotee voice)
bhair-p01-v07.question: What offerings open the heart?
premises: Own-light made, speech-goddess, sense-flower-offering-arranged —
First-unfolding guru, then venerated, heart entered.
bhair-p01-v07.inference: Light made, goddess worded, flowers offered: guru unfolded, heart entered.

bhair-p01-v08.speaker: Kṣemarāja (devotee voice)
bhair-p01-v08.question: What is praised in the body-temple?
premises: I praise, reflecting, great Lord — self, own, consciousness-one-mass.
Poured-out-bond-cluster — in this body-god-house.
bhair-p01-v08.inference: Reflecting praise of own-massed self in body-temple, bonds poured out.

bhair-p01-v09.speaker: Kṣemarāja (devotee voice)
bhair-p01-v09.question: Which powers conquer?
premises: Consciousness-bliss-will-cognition-action-named powers conquer, Lord.
Subtle-gross-splits got — mouth-hood, Brahma-skull-named.
bhair-p01-v09.inference: Five-named powers conquer; splits got, mouths named.

bhair-p01-v10.speaker: Kṣemarāja (devotee voice)
bhair-p01-v10.question: Whose seat to Sadāśiva?
premises: Omniscience-objected, heart and the rest, six-limbed — Yours.
All to Sadāśiva — by corpse-self — Your seat, Lord.
bhair-p01-v10.inference: Limbs Yours to Sadāśiva; corpse-self-seat named.

bhair-p02-v11.speaker: Kṣemarāja (devotee voice)
bhair-p02-v11.question: Whose spread are goddesses?
premises: Supreme-light-bodied reflection-power, Lord — supreme goddess.
Hers indeed spread — all Brahmī-led goddesses.

bhair-p02-v12.speaker: Kṣemarāja (devotee voice)
bhair-p02-v12.question: What opposes, unopposed?
premises: Fire-water-nectar-streak-poison-bearing, You point this.
World opposed though — in true-consciousness-formed, in me unopposed — not this.

bhair-p02-v13.speaker: Kṣemarāja (devotee voice)
bhair-p02-v13.question: What thread dissolves the knower-host?
premises: Knowing-thread-dissolved, sapless knower-host, this —
Skull-garland-of-faculties-bearing, You show thus, as-if, to us, Lord.
bhair-p02-v13.inference: Thread-dissolved sapless shown skull-garlanded as-if to us.

bhair-p02-v14.speaker: Kṣemarāja (devotee voice, commanding)
bhair-p02-v14.question: What expelled shall we see?
premises: See, see — adverse nooses — those, these expelled ever.
Thus entrail-holding-as-if, saying, to us appear.
bhair-p02-v14.inference: Doubled seeing commands; entrail-as-if appears to us.

bhair-p02-v15.speaker: Kṣemarāja (devotee voice)
bhair-p02-v15.question: What cloth is cast in heaven?
premises: Māyā-cloth passionate in supreme heaven — in this that this cast.
Thus elephant-hide bloody on head bearing — You tell, Lord.
bhair-p02-v15.inference: Passionate cloth cast above; bloody hide told.

bhair-p02-v16.speaker: Kṣemarāja (devotee voice)
bhair-p02-v16.question: Who are the best heroes?
premises: Inner-power-dagger bared — saṃsāra-splitting — by sword.
All-world-by-own-power-glory-taken indeed — best heroes.
bhair-p02-v16.inference: Dagger bared splitting; world-taken heroes best.

bhair-p02-v17.speaker: Kṣemarāja (devotee voice)
bhair-p02-v17.question: Why fear not?
premises: World-fear-killer — he, I, in lordship established, am — fear not.
Thus by shield-clash-showing, You point us, Lord.
bhair-p02-v17.inference: Fear-killer established lordly; shield shown pointing.

bhair-p02-v18.speaker: Kṣemarāja (devotee voice)
bhair-p02-v18.question: How is time counted?
premises: Own-power-noose-bound, by consciousness-body counted by me — time.
Thus by noose-holding, You show us death-of-death — You.

bhair-p02-v19.speaker: Kṣemarāja (devotee voice)
bhair-p02-v19.question: What is hurled to destroy?
premises: Distinction-made, all, this, by own power indeed I hurl to destroy.
Thus by goad-holding, supreme Bhairava makes plain to us.
bhair-p02-v19.inference: Hurled to destroy by own power; goad makes plain.

bhair-p02-v20.speaker: Kṣemarāja (devotee voice)
bhair-p02-v20.question: What is pierced like a deer?
premises: By bow-mounted-arrow-showing, Brahmā-Viṣṇu-Rudra-lords with Sadākhya-Śivas —
By power, cause-deer pierced like a deer — You.

bhair-p03-v21.speaker: Kṣemarāja (devotee voice)
bhair-p03-v21.question: What does the boon-hand enact?
premises: By boon-giving hand, You enact universe-glory-giving.
Not indeed supreme-principle-fixed by glory-stains touched ever.

bhair-p03-v22.speaker: Kṣemarāja (devotee voice)
bhair-p03-v22.question: What uproots world-fears?
premises: By fearlessness, world-fears uprooting shown always.
World-grace-cause-nature Yours by palm.

bhair-p03-v23.speaker: Kṣemarāja (devotee voice)
bhair-p03-v23.question: What skull shows waking?
premises: Unfamed-formed, unequal, of Māyā shattered head — there this by supreme waking.
Borne by me, skull — thus You show.
bhair-p03-v23.inference: Māyā-head shattered; skull borne shown waking.

bhair-p03-v24.speaker: Kṣemarāja (devotee voice)
bhair-p03-v24.question: What command by skull-staff pretext?
premises: Wholly-essence-taken, in me, alone world-rest — in consciousness-one-mass thus.
By skull-staff-bone-bearing pretext, You give command.
bhair-p03-v24.inference: Essence-taken rest in mass; pretext commands.

bhair-p03-v25.speaker: Kṣemarāja (devotee voice)
bhair-p03-v25.question: What sound is heard standing?
premises: Lute-bell-drum, O Uddāmara, playing — this You show.
Triple-split function sound hearing, standing am I — thus.

bhair-p03-v26.speaker: Kṣemarāja (devotee voice)
bhair-p03-v26.question: Whom imitate outside?
premises: Moreover — Parā-etc.-power-triple-spoke-lovely great power — gods You imitate outside, by trident-holding pretext, always — You.
bhair-p03-v26.inference: Triple-lovely power imitated outside by trident-pretext always.

bhair-p03-v27.speaker: Kṣemarāja (devotee voice)
bhair-p03-v27.question: What thunderbolt is borne?
premises: Will-etc.-own-power-shown-lower-abode-threefold — own indeed supreme power, thunderbolt-made — borne, six-spoked — You.

bhair-p03-v28.speaker: Kṣemarāja (devotee voice)
bhair-p03-v28.question: What does my power subdue?
premises: World all by my power subdued, all stations holds — thus by staff-holding revealed Consciousness-Bhairava to us.
bhair-p03-v28.inference: Subdued all held; staff-revealed to us.

bhair-p03-v29.speaker: Kṣemarāja (devotee voice)
bhair-p03-v29.question: What splits difference-undifference?
premises: Mace-axe bearing, dot-sound-imitating-formed — distinction-undistinction-splitting-bent, Īśāna, You indicate.

bhair-p03-v30.speaker: Kṣemarāja (devotee voice)
bhair-p03-v30.question: What abode proclaimed everywhere?
premises: By vision-difference, Lord — various form assuming — Bhairava-supreme-waking-made proclaimed — own abode everywhere.
bhair-p03-v30.inference: Assumed various, proclaimed waking-made, abode everywhere.

bhair-p04-v31.speaker: Kṣemarāja (devotee voice)
bhair-p04-v31.question: What is drunk always?
premises: In Śakti-egg-fragment middle, world-juices — all I drink always.
Shown by skull-cup-blood-pretext — this as-it-were my within.
bhair-p04-v31.inference: Egg-middled juices drunk always; shown within as-if.

bhair-p04-v32.speaker: Kṣemarāja (devotee voice)
bhair-p04-v32.question: What holds skull-lotuses?
premises: Pride-heart-bond-uprooters — those two, these tufted embodied — as-it-were skull-lotuses —
Showing, held by You, Mahākāla.

bhair-p04-v33.speaker: Kṣemarāja (devotee voice)
bhair-p04-v33.question: What ground seeds imitation?
premises: All-world-seed-ground, first-station — imitated, treasure-of-waking.
By palm-pomegranate-show-play, O god.

bhair-p04-v34.speaker: Kṣemarāja (devotee voice)
bhair-p04-v34.question: How turn the world by letters?
premises: Bhairava-formed though — in hand rosary held — so by all-letter-expansion world turned within.
bhair-p04-v34.inference: Rosary-held turns world by letters within.

bhair-p04-v35.speaker: Kṣemarāja (devotee voice)
bhair-p04-v35.question: How teach pure through gore?
premises: Bone-handed-skull-garlanded-ash-decked, man-blood-hued — world by Brahma-fullness pure —
Thus the Lord teaches.

bhair-p04-v36.speaker: Kṣemarāja (devotee voice)
bhair-p04-v36.question: What burns before the brow-eye?
premises: For self-delight-full ones — adverse though sense-bubbles — what these desire-burning brow-eye showing supreme-fire-formed teach.
bhair-p04-v36.inference: Bubbles adverse; brow-eye burning shown supreme-fire.

bhair-p04-v37.speaker: Kṣemarāja (devotee voice)
bhair-p04-v37.question: How aim inward-bound?
premises: Inward-bound-aimed, expanding-facultied — though since always You are — that shown in all states, delusion-stain gone self.
bhair-p04-v37.inference: Bound-aimed expanding shows all-states unstained self.

bhair-p04-v38.speaker: Kṣemarāja (devotee voice)
bhair-p04-v38.question: What uncovering says sky-clad?
premises: O god — sky-cladness Yours says uncovered of self form —
Suns-of-supreme-Brahma-fullness — Māyā-covering — how would-cover.
bhair-p04-v38.inference: Sky-clad says uncovered; Māyā-cover how-covering questioned.

bhair-p04-v39.speaker: Kṣemarāja (devotee voice)
bhair-p04-v39.question: Who shows the destroyer?
premises: Destroyer of all, suns and the rest — I, darkness-ground — by spotless-autumn-sky-gleaming body — thus shown.
bhair-p04-v39.inference: Darkness-ground shows destroyer by gleaming body.

bhair-p04-v40.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bhair-p04-v40.question: When freed despite difference?
premises: Supreme-Brahma-full You, god — when taking Bhairava-form — that shown knower-of-principle —
Being though in difference freed — thus.

bhair-p05-v41.speaker: Kṣemarāja (devotee voice)
bhair-p05-v41.question: Who shows amid cremation?
premises: Much-cremation-garland-ghoul-girt, shown sense-field-measuring-midst — Consciousness-Bhairava am I — thus.
bhair-p05-v41.inference: Girt shown measuring midst; Bhairava am I.

bhair-p05-v42.speaker: Kṣemarāja (devotee voice)
bhair-p05-v42.question: What life shines in heart?
premises: In You alone nectar-streak, supreme-power-made, ultimate-knower — hence Lord — You indeed worlds' life — thus shine our in-heart.

bhair-p05-v43.speaker: Kṣemarāja (devotee voice)
bhair-p05-v43.question: What retinue outside?
premises: Yours sound-mass-bodied eightfold-ward just outer-retinue —
By supreme-subtle-splits, Bhairava, world-lord-led.

bhair-p05-v44.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bhair-p05-v44.question: What seals all?
premises: Seals all this by total-own-form-transmission — delights devotee-throng, path-joy, by fullness-showing.

bhair-p05-v45.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bhair-p05-v45.question: What is loosed and called seal?
premises: Looses noose-net, melts distinction — Lord, Your form seals much-consciousness-wealth — seal hence called.

bhair-p05-v46.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bhair-p05-v46.question: What conquers stainlessly?
premises: Conquers in supreme-principle-ground-excellent — draught-become-this — clearly may-it-dwell —
By true-principle-showing, of heart known-stain.
bhair-p05-v46.inference: Conquering draught dwells clearly, heart-stain known.

bhair-p05-v47.speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
bhair-p05-v47.question: What rises momently?
premises: Momently rises consciousness — which indeed there flashes below —
World Śiva-Śakti-glory-formed know, Maheśa, rite-standers.
bhair-p05-v47.inference: Momently rising flashing below; rite-standers know glory-formed world.

bhair-p05-v48.speaker: Kṣemarāja (devotee voice, closing)
bhair-p05-v48.question: How flash effortlessly all?
premises: Thus You flash always in me — Consciousness-Bhairava, all-beings-self —
Then rite-to-mantra-end accomplished effortlessly — all.
bhair-p05-v48.inference: In-me flashing always; rite accomplished effortlessly.

bhair-p01-v01.plain_english: Oṃ. Obeisance to Consciousness-Bhairava. You who shelter in consciousness-ground: take consciousness-state, wander not in vain. Proclaiming thus — Śiva, bent on grace, conquers for devotees.
bhair-p01-v01.sanskrit_cite: oṃ namaś cidbhairavāya | citibhūtiṃ śrayata mā mudhā bhramata

bhair-p01-v02.plain_english: Consciousness-Bhairava alone — supreme, supreme-nectar-formed, one, high-blazing. All swallowed by the ring of shining faculties — Śiva I venerate.
bhair-p01-v02.sanskrit_cite: cidbhairavam eva paraṃ paramāmṛtarūpam | ekam atidīptam

bhair-p01-v03.plain_english: Praised, praiser, praise — though distinct, nothing is here. It endures: as whatever form, by consciousness-form, so becomes this.
bhair-p01-v03.sanskrit_cite: stutyaḥ stotā stutir iti yad api vibhinnaṃ | mṛṣati yathā yad rūpaṃ cidrūpatayā

bhair-p01-v04.plain_english: All-distinctions-melted, all-distinction-self, consciousness-mass-bliss — which Your principle, Lord — its imitation, Your form — I venerate.
bhair-p01-v04.sanskrit_cite: vigalitasarvavibhedaṃ sarvavibhedātma cidghanānandam | tasyānukṛtiṃ tvadākṛtiṃ vande

bhair-p01-v05.plain_english: Outline-man, man, letter-script, letter-mass — just as, just so, of varied form, You — shape reveals, supreme self.
bhair-p01-v05.sanskrit_cite: rekhāpuruṣaḥ puruṣaṃ varṇalipir varṇasaṃcayaṃ yadvat | tadvat vicitrarūpaṃ tvām ākāro vyanakti paramātman

bhair-p01-v06.plain_english: There concept-free indeed — You consciousness-formed entered — we reflect: what even a bit? Not indeed principle fancy's-object.
bhair-p01-v06.sanskrit_cite: tatrāvikalpam eva tvāṃ cidrūpaṃ samāviśya | vimṛśāmaḥ kim api manāṅ na hi tattvaṃ kalpanāviṣayaḥ

bhair-p01-v07.plain_english: Own-light made, speech-goddess, sense-flowers-offering-arranged — first-unfolding guru, then venerated, heart entered.
bhair-p01-v07.sanskrit_cite: svātmaprabhāṃ vidhāya vāgdevīṃ | prathamonmeṣaṃ gurum atha vanditvā hṛdayam āviśya

bhair-p01-v08.plain_english: I praise, reflecting, the Great Lord — self, own, consciousness-one-mass. Poured-out-bond-cluster — in this body-god-house.
bhair-p01-v08.sanskrit_cite: staumi vimṛśan maheśvaram ātmānaṃ svaṃ cidekaghanam | srāvitapāśakadambakam etasmin dehadevagṛhe

bhair-p01-v09.plain_english: Consciousness-bliss-will-cognition-action-named powers conquer, O Lord. Having got subtle-gross splits — mouth-hood, Brahma-skull-named.
bhair-p01-v09.sanskrit_cite: cityānandecchāvitkaraṇākhyāḥ śaktayo jayanti | sūkṣmasthūlabhidāptā vaktratvaṃ brahmamuṇḍabhidhā

bhair-p01-v10.plain_english: Omniscience-objected, heart and the rest, six-limbed — Yours. All up to Sadāśiva — by corpse-self — Your seat, O Lord.
bhair-p01-v10.sanskrit_cite: sarvajñatādiviṣayaṃ hṛdayādikam aṅgaṣaṭkaṃ te | sakalaṃ sadāśivāntaṃ pretātmatayā tavāsanaṃ svāmin

bhair-p02-v11.plain_english: Of supreme-light-bodied, reflection-power, O Lord — supreme goddess. Hers indeed spread — all Brahmī-led goddesses.
bhair-p02-v11.sanskrit_cite: paramaprakāśavapuṣo vimarśaśaktiḥ prabho parā devī | asyā eva prasaraḥ sarvā brāhmyādikā devyaḥ

bhair-p02-v12.plain_english: Fire-water-nectar-streak-poison-bearing, You point this. World opposed though — in true-consciousness-formed, in me unopposed — not this.
bhair-p02-v12.sanskrit_cite: dahanajalāmṛtalekhāviṣādi bibhrat tvam ādiśasy etat | viśvaṃ viruddham api saccidrūpe mayi virudhyate naitat

bhair-p02-v13.plain_english: Knowing-thread-dissolved, sapless knower-host, this — skull-garland-of-faculties-bearing, You show thus, as-if, to us, O Lord.
bhair-p02-v13.sanskrit_cite: saṃvitsūtranilīno niḥsāro mātṛnivaho 'yam | karaṇamuṇḍamālabhārin darśayasītīva naḥ svāmin

bhair-p02-v14.plain_english: See, see — adverse nooses — those, these expelled ever. Thus entrail-holding-as-if, saying, to us appear.
bhair-p02-v14.sanskrit_cite: paśyata paśyata pāśā viṣamās ta ime bahiṣkṛtāḥ śaśvat | antradhāraṇamiṣat kathayaṃs tvaṃ naḥ samābhāsi

bhair-p02-v15.plain_english: Māyā-cloth passionate in supreme heaven — in this that this cast. Thus elephant-hide bloody on head bearing — You tell, O Lord.
bhair-p02-v15.sanskrit_cite: māyāpaṭaḥ sarāgo vyomni pare 'smin sa eṣa nikṣiptaḥ | gajacarma saraktaṃ mūrdhni vahan kathayasīśa

bhair-p02-v16.plain_english: Inner-power-dagger bared — saṃsāra-splitting — by sword. All-world-by-own-power-glory-taken indeed — best heroes.
bhair-p02-v16.sanskrit_cite: antaḥśaktikṛpāṇīm vyanakṣi saṃsṛtivibhedinīm asinā | nijaśaktimahimasvīkṛtasamastaviśvā hi vīravarāḥ

bhair-p02-v17.plain_english: World-fear-killer — he, I, in lordship established, am — fear not. Thus by shield-clash-showing, You point us, O Lord.
bhair-p02-v17.sanskrit_cite: bhavabhayahantā so 'ham sānāthye 'vasthito 'smi | mā bhaiṣṭa ity āsphoṭitakheṭakadarśanato diśasi naḥ svāmin

bhair-p02-v18.plain_english: Own-power-noose-bound, by consciousness-body, time is counted by me. Thus by noose-holding, You show us death-of-death — You.
bhair-p02-v18.sanskrit_cite: nijaśaktipāśavalitaś cidvapuṣā kalyate mayā kālaḥ | pāśadhāraṇavaśāt prathayasi naḥ kālakālas tvam

bhair-p02-v19.plain_english: Distinction-made, all, this, by own power indeed I hurl to destroy. Thus by goad-holding, supreme Bhairava makes plain to us.
bhair-p02-v19.sanskrit_cite: bhedamayam akhilam etan nijaśaktyaivākṣipāmi saṃhartum | aṅkuśadhāraṇataḥ sphuṭayati parabhairavo 'smākam

bhair-p02-v20.plain_english: By bow-mounted-arrow-showing, Brahmā-Viṣṇu-Rudra-lords with Sadākhya-Śivas — by power, cause-deer pierced like a deer — You.
bhair-p02-v20.sanskrit_cite: kodaṇḍārūdhaśarapradarśanād | brahmaviṣṇurudreśān sasadākhyaśivāñ chaktyā kāraṇahariṇaṃ bhinatsi mṛgavat tvam

bhair-p03-v21.plain_english: By the boon-giving hand, You enact universe-glory-giving. Not indeed supreme-principle-fixed by glory-stains touched ever.
bhair-p03-v21.sanskrit_cite: varadena pāṇinā tvaṃ viśvavibhūtipradatvam abhinayasi na khalu paratattvaniṣṭho vibhavamalaiḥ spṛśyate jātu

bhair-p03-v22.plain_english: By fearlessness, world-fears uprooting shown always. World-grace-cause-nature Yours by palm.
bhair-p03-v22.sanskrit_cite: abhayena ca bhavabhayāni unmūlayatā prakāśyate satatam viśvānugrahakāraṇasvabhāvatā tava karatalena

bhair-p03-v23.plain_english: Unfamed-formed, unequal, Māyā's shattered head — there this, by supreme waking, borne by me as skull — thus You show.
bhair-p03-v23.sanskrit_cite: akhyātirūpam asamaṃ māyāyāḥ śakalitaṃ śiro 'traitat parabodhamayena mayā muṇḍaṃ bibhrat prakāśayasy evam

bhair-p03-v24.plain_english: Wholly-essence-taken, in me, alone world-rest — in consciousness-one-mass thus. By skull-staff-bone-bearing pretext, You give command.
bhair-p03-v24.sanskrit_cite: niḥśeṣahṛtasārā mayy eva jagatsthitiś cidekaghane iti khaṭvāṅgakaraṅkodvahanacchalato dadāsy ājñām

bhair-p03-v25.plain_english: Lute-bell-drum, O Uddāmara, playing — this You show. Triple-split function sound hearing, standing am I — thus.
bhair-p03-v25.sanskrit_cite: vīṇāghaṇtāḍamarūn uḍḍāmara vādayann idaṃ diśasi vṛttitribhedabhinnaṃ nādaṃ śṛṇvan sthito 'smīti

bhair-p03-v26.plain_english: Moreover — Parā-etc.-power-triple-spoke-lovely great power — gods You imitate outside, by trident-holding pretext, always — You.
bhair-p03-v26.sanskrit_cite: kiṃ ca parādikaśaktitritayārāsundarām mahāśaktim devānukaroṣi bahis triśūladhāraṇamiṣeṇa nityaṃ tvam

bhair-p03-v27.plain_english: Will-etc.-own-power-shown-lower-abode-threefold — own indeed supreme power, thunderbolt-made — borne, six-spoked — You.
bhair-p03-v27.sanskrit_cite: icchādikanijaśaktiprakāśitādhaḥsthagocaratritayām svām eva parāṃ śaktiṃ vajramayīṃ vahasi ṣaḍarāṃ tvam

bhair-p03-v28.plain_english: World all by my power subdued, all stations holds — thus by staff-holding revealed Consciousness-Bhairava to us.
bhair-p03-v28.sanskrit_cite: jagad akhilaṃ macchaktyā damitaṃ sarvavyāvasthitīr dhatte iti daṇḍadhāraṇavaśād vyanakṣi cidbhairavāsmākam

bhair-p03-v29.plain_english: Mace-axe bearing, dot-sound-imitating-formed — distinction-undistinction-splitting-bent, O Īśāna — You indicate.
bhair-p03-v29.sanskrit_cite: mudgaraparaśū bibhrad baindavanādānukārarūpau tvam bhedavibhedanaśakalanaparatvam īśāna nirdiśasi

bhair-p03-v30.plain_english: By vision-difference, O Lord — various form assuming — Bhairava-supreme-waking-made proclaimed — own abode everywhere.
bhair-p03-v30.sanskrit_cite: darśanabhedāt svāminn anyānyām āhṛtiṃ dadhānas tvam bhairavaparabodhamayaṃ prathayasi nijadhāma sarvatra

bhair-p04-v31.plain_english: In Śakti-egg-fragment middle, world-juices — all I drink always. Shown by skull-cup-blood-pretext — this as-it-were my within.
bhair-p04-v31.sanskrit_cite: śāktāṇḍakhaṇḍamadhye viśvarasāḥ sarvam ahaṃ pibāmi sadā vyañjayasi narakapālagarudhiramiṣād etad iva me 'ntaḥ

bhair-p04-v32.plain_english: Pride-heart-bond-uprooters — those two, these tufted embodied — as-it-were skull-lotuses — showing, held by You, Mahākāla.
bhair-p04-v32.sanskrit_cite: abhimānahṛdayabandhānutkhātau tāv imau saśikhau mūrtāv iva muṇdābjau prathayan dhatse mahākālaḥ

bhair-p04-v33.plain_english: All-world-seed-ground, first-station — imitated, treasure-of-waking. By palm-pomegranate-show-play, O god.
bhair-p04-v33.sanskrit_cite: akhilajagadbījabhuvaṃ prathamasthām anukaroṣi bodhanidhe karatalagabījapūrakadarśanalīlāyitād deva

bhair-p04-v34.plain_english: Bhairava-formed though — in hand rosary held — so by all-letter-expansion world turned within.
bhair-p04-v34.sanskrit_cite: bhairavarūpo 'py asi yat tatrāpi kare 'kṣamālikāṃ dhatse tat sarvākṣavikāsād viśvaṃ parivartayasy antaḥ

bhair-p04-v35.plain_english: Bone-handed-skull-garlanded-ash-decked, man-blood-hued — world by Brahma-fullness pure — thus the Lord teaches.
bhair-p04-v35.sanskrit_cite: asthikaramuṇḍamālābhasmābharaṇo nṛraktaruciḥ viśvaṃ brahmamayatvāc chuddham itīśaḥ samādiśasi

bhair-p04-v36.plain_english: For self-delight-full ones — adverse though sense-bubbles — what these desire-burning brow-eye showing supreme-fire-formed teach.
bhair-p04-v36.sanskrit_cite: svātmārāmamayānāṃ viṣamā api viṣayabudbudhāḥ kim amī smaradahanam alikanayanam prathayan paramāgnirūpam ādiśasi

bhair-p04-v37.plain_english: Inward-bound-aimed, expanding-facultied — though since always You are — that shown in all states, delusion-stain gone self.
bhair-p04-v37.sanskrit_cite: antarnibaddhalakṣyaḥ pravikāsikaraṇo 'pi yat sadā bhavasi tat prathayasi sarvadaśaṃ gatamohakalaṅkam ātmānam

bhair-p04-v38.plain_english: O god — sky-cladness Yours says uncovered of self form — suns-of-supreme-Brahma-fullness — Māyā-covering — how would-cover?
bhair-p04-v38.sanskrit_cite: deva digambaratā te vadati nirāvaraṇam ātmano rūpam paramabrahmamayārkān māyāvaraṇam kathaṃ vṛṇuyāt

bhair-p04-v39.plain_english: Destroyer of all, suns and the rest — I, darkness-ground — by spotless-autumn-sky-gleaming body — thus shown.
bhair-p04-v39.sanskrit_cite: saṃhartā sarveṣām arkādīnām ahaṃ tamobhūmiḥ nirmalaśāradagaganaprabheṇa vapuṣeti darśayasi

bhair-p04-v40.plain_english: Supreme-Brahma-full You, god — when taking Bhairava-form — that shown knower-of-principle — being though in difference freed — thus.
bhair-p04-v40.sanskrit_cite: paramabrahmamayas tvaṃ deva yadāśrayasi bhairavākāram tat prathayasi tattvajñaḥ saty api bhede vimukta iti

bhair-p05-v41.plain_english: Much-cremation-garland-ghoul-girt, shown sense-field-measuring-midst — Consciousness-Bhairava am I — thus.

bhair-p05-v42.plain_english: In You alone nectar-streak, supreme-power-made, ultimate-knower — hence Lord — You indeed worlds' life — thus shine our in-heart.
bhair-p05-v42.sanskrit_cite: tvayy evāmṛtalekhā paraśaktimayī parapramātātaḥ nātha tvam eva jagatām jīvanam iti bhāsi no hṛdaye

bhair-p05-v43.plain_english: Yours sound-mass-bodied eightfold-ward just outer-retinue — by supreme-subtle-splits, Bhairava, world-lord-led.
bhair-p05-v43.sanskrit_cite: tava śabdarāśivapuṣaḥ pratyaṣṭakam eva bāhyaparivāraḥ parasūkṣmādivibhedād bhairava lokeśvarapramukhāḥ

bhair-p05-v44.plain_english: Seals all this by total-own-form-transmission — delights devotee-throng, path-joy, by fullness-showing.
bhair-p05-v44.sanskrit_cite: mudrayati nikhilam etan niḥśeṣasvasvarūpasaṃkramaṇāt modayati bhaktavargaṃ gatimudaṃ pūrṇatāprathanāt

bhair-p05-v45.plain_english: Looses noose-net, melts distinction — O Lord, Your form seals much-consciousness-wealth — seal hence called.
bhair-p05-v45.sanskrit_cite: mocayati pāśajālaṃ drāvayati vibhedam īśa te mūrtiḥ mudrayati vividhasaṃviddraviṇaṃ mudrā tataḥ kathitā

bhair-p05-v46.plain_english: Conquers in supreme-principle-ground-excellent — draught-become-this — clearly may it dwell — by true-principle-showing, of heart known-stain.
bhair-p05-v46.sanskrit_cite: jayati paratattvabhūmipravare nipāyabhūtaiṣa sphuṭam adhivasatu satattvaprathayā hṛdayasya meyamalam

bhair-p05-v47.plain_english: Momently rises consciousness — which indeed there flashes below — world Śiva-Śakti-glory-formed know, Maheśa, rite-standers.
bhair-p05-v47.sanskrit_cite: pratikalam udeti saṃvid yā kila tatra sphuraty adho viśvam śivaśaktivibhavarūpaṃ jānanti maheśa yāgasthāḥ

bhair-p05-v48.plain_english: Thus You flash always in me — Consciousness-Bhairava, all-beings-self — then rite-to-mantra-end accomplished effortlessly — all.
bhair-p05-v48.sanskrit_cite: itthaṃ sphurasi sadā me cidbhairava sarvabhūtātma tad yāgādijapāntaṃ sampannam ayatnataḥ sarvam

essence: Alone supreme nectar-one ablaze, all-swallowed: venerated.
Melted bliss-mass; principle likened in form venerated.
Script-outlines man; shape reveals varied You.
Light-goddess-flowers arranged; guru unfolded, heart entered.
Reflecting praise in body-temple, bonds outpoured.
Five-named conquer; splits gained, mouths called.

sections.SUMMARY: Oṃ to Consciousness-Bhairava; shelter-takers take knowing, wander never vain; grace-bent Śiva conquers. Bhairava alone supreme nectar-one ablaze; sense-ring-swallowed all; venerated. Praised-praiser-praise though distinct undiffering; whatever formed by knowing becomes this, enduring. All melted, bliss-massed; Your principle's likeness in Your shape venerated. Letter-script outlines man; shape reveals varied-formed You, supreme self. Concept-free entered; we reflect what fancy never catches. Made, worded, offered: guru unfolded then heart entered. Mirroring praise of own-massed self; bonds outpoured in body-temple. Named powers conquer; splits gained, mouths skull-called. Objected limbs Yours to Sadāśiva; corpse-self Your seat.

essence: Borne pointed; opposed unopposed in me.
Impassioned cloth cast; bloodied hide told.
Dagger bared splitting; taken-world heroes best.
Noosed time counted; death's death shown.
Hurled to unmake; goad makes plain.
Bow shown, lords arrayed; cause-deer deer-pierced.

sections.SUMMARY: Light-bodied thought-power supreme goddess; hers the spreading of all. Bearing shown; world-opposed in me true-formed unopposed. Thread dissolved, sapless crowd; garland shown as-if to us. Look doubled at expelled nooses; gut-holding as-if appears speaking. Passionate cloth cast in highest heaven; bloodied hide head-borne told. Bared splitting by sword; world-taken heroes best. Fear-slayer lorded standing; shield-clash pointing us. Self-noosed, knowing-bodied, I count time; noose-held shown death's death. Difference-made hurled to unmake by own power; goad-held plain by supreme Bhairava. Bow-shown, lords arrayed; cause-deer pierced deer-like by power.

essence: Taken rest in mass; pretext commands.

sections.SUMMARY: Boon hand enacts glory-giving; principle-fixed glory-stainless ever. Fearless uprooting always shown; grace-cause-nature palmed. Māyā's shattered head borne by supreme waking shown. Essence-taken rest massed; skull-pretext commands. Wild-played instruments shown; triple-split sound heard standing. Parā-triple lovely imitated gods-outside, trident-pretext, always. Will-shown lower-three; thunder-made power six-spoked borne. World tamed all-held; staff-held Bhairava revealed to us. Mace-axe borne bindu-mirrored; split-bent pointed. Vision-differed assumed; waking-made proclaimed; abode everywhere.

essence: Egg-middled saps drunk; shown within as-if.
Rosary held turns world within by letters.
Bubbles jar; brow-eye burning taught supreme-fire.
Aimed inward expanding shows unstained self all-states.
Sky-clad speaks bare; veil questioned covering.
Destroyer shown gleaming-bodied from dark ground.

sections.SUMMARY: Power-egg-middled saps all drunk always; within shown as-if. Pride-bond uprooters crested embodied lotus-shown, held. Seed-ground first mirrored waking-treasure; pomegranate show-played. Though Bhairava-shaped, rosary-held turns world within by letters. Bone-skull-ash-blood decked teaches world pure by Brahma-fullness. Self-pleased adverse bubbles; desire-burning brow-eye supreme-fire taught. Inward-aimed expanding shows unstained self in every state. Sky-cladness speaks self bare; how should Māyā's veil cover suns? All-destroyer shown from darkness-ground, gleaming-bodied. Brahma-full wearing Bhairava-form shown; differing yet freed.

essence: Sealed all delighted throng by fullness-shown.
Conquering draught dwells clearly; stain known.
In-me flashing sealed; rite complete effortless.

sections.SUMMARY: Cremation-girt shown measuring midst; Bhairava am I. Alone-nectar-knower; worlds'-life shining heartward. Sound-bodied eightfold-ward outer retinue, finest-split led. All sealed by total-transmission; throng gladdened by fullness-shown. Noose-net loosed, distinction melted; shape seals knowing-wealth: seal called. Conquered ground excellent, draught-become dwelling clearly; stain known by truth-showing. Each moment knowing rises flashing below; glory-formed world known by rite-standers. Thus flashed in me always; rite-to-mantra-end complete effortlessly.

lines: Oṃ — bow to Consciousness-Bhairava.
Shelter-takers, take knowing's state, never wander vain — grace-bent Śiva conquers.
bhair-p01-v01.sanskrit_cite: oṃ namaś cidbhairavāya | citibhūtiṃ śrayata mā mudhā bhramata

lines: Consciousness-Bhairava alone — supreme, nectar-formed supreme, one, ablaze;
all swallowed in shining senses' ring — Śiva I praise.
bhair-p01-v02.sanskrit_cite: cidbhairavam eva paraṃ paramāmṛtarūpam | ekam atidīptam

lines: Praised, praiser, praise — though three, nothing here apart;
it holds: whatever shape, by knowing-shape, so this becomes.

there, by supreme waking borne — thus You show.

bent on splitting split-un-split, Īśāna, You point.
bhair-p03-v29.sanskrit_cite: mudgaraparaśū bibhrad baindavanādānukārarūpau tvam bhedavibhedanaśakalanaparatvam īśāna nirdiśasi

lines: By differing visions, Lord — shapes assumed and shed —
waking-made-Bhairava proclaimed — own abode, everywhere.

lines: Pride-heart-bond uprooters — those two, these crested embodied —

lines: Bhairava-shaped though — rosary in hand held —
so by every letter's opening, turn the world within.

lines: Bone in hand, skulls garlanded, ash-smeared, man-blood-red —
world by Brahma-fullness pure — so teaches the Lord.

bhair-p04-v36.sanskrit_cite: svātmārāmamayānāṃ viṣamā api viṣayabudbudhāḥ kim amī smaradahanam alikanayanam prathayan paramāgnirūpam ādiśasi

lines: Inward tied-aimed, faculties spread — though You ever are —
that shown in every state — delusion-stained-gone self.

bhair-p04-v39.sanskrit_cite: saṃhartā sarveṣām arkādīnām ahaṃ tamobhūmiḥ nirmalaśāradagaganaprabheṇa vapuṣeti darśayasi

that shown — principle-knower — being, though parted, freed.

lines: It seals all this — total self-form given over —

bhair-p05-v44.sanskrit_cite: mudrayati nikhilam etan niḥśeṣasvasvarūpasaṃkramaṇāt modayati bhaktavargaṃ gatimudaṃ pūrṇatāprathanāt
